name: marker-report
description: The full state of every marker: where it started, where it is, what it is made of, and — if it has been drawn — which drawpoint took it and on what day. Extracted markers are listed first, then unextracted ones.

layout.default_filename: massflow_Day<N>.txt, where N is the current flow day

columns.name: MarkerID
columns.description: Marker ID.

columns.name: xStart, yStart, zStart
columns.description: Where the marker was created.

columns.name: xCurrent, yCurrent, zCurrent
columns.description: Current position, or -99 -99 -99 if the marker has been extracted.

columns.name: ParentBlock
columns.description: ID of the mine block the marker came from.

columns.name: Active
columns.description: 1 if the marker moved during the current period, else 0.

columns.name: Grade1..GradeN
columns.description: The extra ore-grade columns of the block model, under their own headings.

columns.name: Mass
columns.description: Mass carried by the marker.

columns.name: Volume
columns.description: Volume carried by the marker, spacing^3 / (1 - porosity).

columns.name: Porosity
columns.description: Marker porosity.

columns.name: SolidDen
columns.description: Solids density of the host mine block.

columns.name: BulkDen
columns.description: Bulk density of the host block, density * (1 - porosity).

columns.name: FricAng
columns.description: Friction angle of the host block.

columns.name: FragDia
columns.description: Fragment diameter carried by the marker.

columns.name: ShearStr
columns.description: Shear strain accumulated by the marker.

columns.name: Work
columns.description: Work accumulated by the marker.

columns.name: DPEnd
columns.description: Name of the drawpoint that extracted the marker, or null.

columns.name: DayExtr
columns.description: Day of extraction, or -99.

columns.name: MassExtr
columns.description: Cumulative mass extracted, or -99.

columns.name: Type
columns.description: Marker type: -2 unbulked for IMZ growth, -1 unbulked for collapse, 0 unbulked for rilling, 1 partially bulked, 2 fully bulked, 3 air.

columns.name: TensileStrength
columns.description: Tensile strength carried by the marker.

notes: `massflow marker report-days` / `report-period` schedule the report to be written automatically during the run; `report-export` writes one immediately.

The manual disagrees with itself about the type codes: this section lists five (-2 to 2), while the FISH page for massflow.marker.type lists six, adding `3: air`. The engine takes the FISH page's side — `range marker-type` accepts -2 to 3.
`TensileStrength` appears in the `report-export` output but not in the trace-marker report, which otherwise shares the column set.
official_documentation: Itasca 9.7 MassFlow manual: command pages + 'MassFlow Theory and Background' > Model Inputs / Model Outputs
